task.name: Execute Subagent
task.objective: Reliable multi-backend subagent execution with exit code capture, sentinel validation, retry/fallback, and structured output

llm.mandate: Execute specified backend: claude (Task tool), gemini (CLI), or codex (CLI)
Return structured output with success status, changed files, and summary
Never modify files outside the specified story scope
Always run CLI backends SYNCHRONOUSLY — never use nohup or background (&)
Always stage prompts in temp files first — pass via $(cat) to avoid shell escaping issues and enable size guards
Always inject sentinel file instruction into every subagent prompt
Track consecutive failures per backend; fall back to `codex exec` after 2 consecutive failures (override with NOUS_ALLOW_CLAUDE_API=1 to route through `claude -p` instead)

input.name: backend
input.desc: claude | gemini | codex — MUST be passed explicitly from resolved profile, never defaulted

input.name: story_id
input.desc: Story identifier, used for temp files, sentinel files, and log naming

input.name: agent_persona
input.desc: e.g., dev, sm for BMAD agent context

input.name: lock_file
input.desc: Path to parallel lock file for coordination

input.name: constraints
input.desc: Merged cannot_do/must_do constraints for this phase (from config.yaml constraints section)

input.name: codex_agent
input.desc: Optional Codex agent name from .codex/agents/ (e.g., 'review-correctness', 'review-security'). When set, adds --agent flag to codex exec.

input.name: fix_scope
input.desc: Fix scope discriminator ('critical' or 'minor') for parallel fix workers. Used to disambiguate artifact paths when multiple fix agents run for the same story.

input.name: consecutive_failures
input.desc: Running count of consecutive failures for the current backend (caller tracks across invocations)

step.title: Validate Backend and Load Context
step.action: Validate backend parameter is one of: claude, gemini, codex
If story_path provided, read story file for context
If workflow_path provided, validate workflow exists
If lock_file provided, check lock before proceeding
Ensure output directories exist: `mkdir -p _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts`
Calculate TIMEOUT_SECONDS: `TIMEOUT_SECONDS=$((timeout_minutes * 60))`

Detect timeout command (macOS portability): ```bash # GNU timeout is required. On macOS, install via: brew install coreutils if command -v timeout > /dev/null 2>&1; then TIMEOUT_CMD="timeout" elif command -v gtimeout > /dev/null 2>&1; then TIMEOUT_CMD="gtimeout" else echo "WARNING: Neither timeout nor gtimeout found. Executing without timeout wrapper." TIMEOUT_CMD="" fi ```

check.action: Read lock file to get claimed files
Parse story for files to modify
If any target files already claimed by another story, HALT with conflict error
Claim our files in the lock (add to files_claimed)
Update heartbeat timestamp

Append constraints block to prompt: ``` ## Constraints (MANDATORY) You CANNOT do any of the following: {for each constraint in constraints.cannot_do: "- {constraint}"}
You MUST do all of the following: {for each requirement in constraints.must_do: "- {requirement}"} ```

step.title: Compute Invocation Suffix
step.action: Compute per-invocation discriminator for artifact path uniqueness: ```bash # When codex_agent or fix_scope is set, include it in artifact paths # to prevent collisions between parallel workers for the same story. # Examples: .codex-review-correctness-story1.log, .codex-minor-story1.log INVOCATION_SUFFIX="" if [ -n "${codex_agent:-}" ]; then INVOCATION_SUFFIX="-${codex_agent}" elif [ -n "${fix_scope:-}" ]; then INVOCATION_SUFFIX="-${fix_scope}" fi ```

step.title: Inject Completion Sentinel Instruction
step.action: Append the following to the prompt (ALL backends, including claude). Use the INVOCATION_SUFFIX computed in step 2.6 for parallel-safe sentinel paths: ``` ## Completion Sentinel (MANDATORY — DO NOT SKIP) Your FINAL action before finishing must be to create this file: `_bmad-output/.complete${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}-{story_id}.json` with this exact JSON content: { "story_id": "{story_id}", "status": "completed", "files_changed": ["list", "of", "files", "you", "modified"], "summary": "One-paragraph summary of what you did" } If you encounter an error that prevents completion, still create the file but set status to "failed" and include an "error" field explaining why. ```

step.title: Write Prompt to Temp File and Check Size
step.action: Define prompt file path using INVOCATION_SUFFIX from step 2.6: `PROMPT_FILE="/tmp/orchestrator-prompt-{story_id}-{backend}${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}.md"`
Write the fully-assembled prompt (with constraints + sentinel instruction) to PROMPT_FILE
Check prompt size: ```bash PROMPT_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$PROMPT_FILE") ```

check.action: ABORT with error: "Prompt too large for {backend} ({PROMPT_BYTES} bytes, limit 500000)"
Set status to "failed", set error message, skip to step 5
Log WARNING: "Large prompt for {backend}: {PROMPT_BYTES} bytes — may degrade performance"
Continue execution (do not abort)

step.title: Execute Subagent
step.action: Define common variables (INVOCATION_SUFFIX already computed in step 2.6): ```bash # INVOCATION_SUFFIX is set in step 2.6 — reuse it here for all artifact paths. # All paths include the suffix so parallel workers don't collide. LOG_FILE="_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/.{backend}${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}-{story_id}.log" SENTINEL="_bmad-output/.complete${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}-{story_id}.json" PROMPT_FILE="/tmp/orchestrator-prompt-{story_id}-{backend}${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}.md" TIMEOUT_SECONDS=$((timeout_minutes * 60)) ```

check.action: Build prompt with agent_persona context if specified
Use Claude Code Task tool with subagent_type="{agent_persona}" (default: "Software Developer")
Pass full prompt from PROMPT_FILE including story context and workflow reference
Monitor for timeout (timeout_minutes)
Capture Task tool success/failure as EXIT_CODE (0 = success, 1 = failure)
Determine if this is a REVIEW phase task (check if constraints or prompt contain "review" keywords)

Build command with file-based prompt and optional @file context: ```bash # For review tasks with story_path: use Gemini's @file syntax for direct file inclusion # For implementation tasks: story context is already in the prompt file
if [review task AND story_path provided]; then ${TIMEOUT_CMD:+$TIMEOUT_CMD --signal=SIGTERM --kill-after=60 $TIMEOUT_SECONDS} \ gemini -p "$(cat "$PROMPT_FILE")" @{story_path} \ > "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 else ${TIMEOUT_CMD:+$TIMEOUT_CMD --signal=SIGTERM --kill-after=60 $TIMEOUT_SECONDS} \ gemini -p "$(cat "$PROMPT_FILE")" \ > "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 fi EXIT_CODE=$? ```
CRITICAL: Run synchronously — do NOT background with & or nohup
CRITICAL: Never read full log into context. On failure only: `tail -30 "$LOG_FILE"`

Build and execute command: ```bash # ALWAYS use --json to capture measured token usage from turn.completed events. # Token data is extracted via parse_codex_jsonl_usage() after execution. # # If codex_agent is specified, use --agent flag to route to specialized agent # from .codex/agents/{codex_agent}.toml (e.g., review-correctness, review-security). # The agent config sets model, reasoning effort, and developer instructions. CODEX_AGENT_FLAG="" if [ -n "${codex_agent:-}" ]; then CODEX_AGENT_FLAG="--agent ${codex_agent}" fi
${TIMEOUT_CMD:+$TIMEOUT_CMD --signal=SIGTERM --kill-after=60 $TIMEOUT_SECONDS} \ codex exec -c approval_mode="full-auto" $CODEX_AGENT_FLAG --json \ "$(cat "$PROMPT_FILE")" \ > "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 EXIT_CODE=$? ```
CRITICAL: Run synchronously — do NOT background with & or nohup
CRITICAL: Uses `-c approval_mode="full-auto"` (NOT the deprecated `--full-auto` flag)

Parse JSONL for token usage and assign token_usage output: ```bash # Extract measured token counts from turn.completed events in JSONL log. # Sum across all turns for multi-turn sessions. read CODEX_INPUT_TOKENS CODEX_OUTPUT_TOKENS CODEX_CACHED_TOKENS <<< \ $(grep '"turn.completed"' "$LOG_FILE" | python3 -c " import sys, json total_in, total_out, total_cached = 0, 0, 0 for line in sys.stdin: ev = json.loads(line) u = ev.get('usage', {}) total_in += u.get('input_tokens', 0) total_out += u.get('output_tokens', 0) total_cached += u.get('cached_input_tokens', 0) print(f'{total_in} {total_out} {total_cached}') ")
# Assign the token_usage output (returned to caller) TOKEN_USAGE_MEASURED=true ```

Set the `token_usage` output from parsed values: ``` token_usage = { "input_tokens": CODEX_INPUT_TOKENS, "output_tokens": CODEX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, "cached_input_tokens": CODEX_CACHED_TOKENS, "measured": true } ``` If CODEX_INPUT_TOKENS is empty or 0 (parsing failed), set token_usage to null and log warning: "Could not parse token usage from Codex JSONL output"
CRITICAL: Never read full log into context. On failure only: `tail -30 "$LOG_FILE"`

step.action: Interpret EXIT_CODE (applies to gemini and codex backends): - EXIT_CODE=0 → command completed normally - EXIT_CODE=124 → timeout: SIGTERM was sent and process exited - EXIT_CODE=137 → timeout: SIGKILL was sent (process ignored SIGTERM for 60s) - EXIT_CODE!=0 (other) → command failed

error_classification.transient_patterns: rate.?limit | 429 | Too.?Many.?Requests | connection.?refused | connection.?reset | network.?timeout | timed?\s*out | ETIMEDOUT | ECONNREFUSED | ECONNRESET | 503.*Service.*Unavailable | server\s+error | temporarily.?unavailable | usage.?limit | hit.?your.*limit | gemini.*timeout | gemini.*timed out | gemini.*killed
error_classification.permanent_patterns: auth.*error | authentication.*failed | invalid.*token | expired.*token | command not found | No such file or directory | permission denied.*(codex|gemini) | not installed | EACCES | spawn.*ENOENT

parse_failure_patterns.desc: Codex --json output truncated or malformed — same backend, retry once with smaller chunk before falling back

error_classification.parse_failure_patterns: codex.*parse.*failed | JSONDecodeError | Unexpected end of JSON | Expecting value | unterminated string | turn\.completed.*missing
error_classification.action_transient: Skip consecutive_failures increment. Sleep with jitter (1-3s), then attempt immediate backend fallback via `codex exec`.
error_classification.action_permanent: Halt pipeline. Report exact error to user. Do NOT retry or fall back.
error_classification.action_parse_failure: Retry SAME backend ONCE with `--chunk-size` halved or prompt simplified (drop optional context). If retry also fails, escalate to transient handling (jitter + fallback). This is the specific remedy for the recurring `codex-parse-failed` portfolio signal.
error_classification.action_tool_logic: Increment consecutive_failures. Follow existing retry logic below.

step.title: Error Classification + Retry with Mini-Executor Fallback
step.action: Initialize: RETRY_COUNT=0, FALLBACK_USED=false, ERROR_CLASS="unknown", PARSE_RETRY_USED=false

check.action: Capture log tail for classification: `ERROR_TAIL=$(tail -30 "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "no log available")`

check.if: ERROR_TAIL matches parse_failure_patterns AND PARSE_RETRY_USED = false
check.action: Log: "PARSE FAILURE detected on {backend} — attempting same-backend retry with reduced context"
Set PARSE_RETRY_USED=true
Sleep with jitter to avoid thundering-herd: `sleep $(awk -v min=1 -v max=3 'BEGIN{srand(); print min+rand()*(max-min)}')`

Reduce prompt size for the retry: ```bash # Drop optional sections (constraints, sentinel) and try again — the # most common cause of parse failures is prompt overflow, not real # CLI error. Keep core task + boundaries only. PROMPT_FILE_SMALL="/tmp/orchestrator-prompt-{story_id}-{backend}${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}-small.md" head -100 "$PROMPT_FILE" > "$PROMPT_FILE_SMALL" echo "" >> "$PROMPT_FILE_SMALL" echo "## Completion Sentinel (MANDATORY)" >> "$PROMPT_FILE_SMALL" echo "Final action: write _bmad-output/.complete${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}-{story_id}.json with status field." >> "$PROMPT_FILE_SMALL" ```

Re-execute SAME backend command with PROMPT_FILE_SMALL instead of PROMPT_FILE. Capture new EXIT_CODE. If still non-zero, fall through to normal classification below (which will treat it as transient + jitter-fallback since gemini-timeout / parse failures both end up in transient_patterns).
Set RETRY_COUNT=1
ERROR_TAIL=$(tail -30 "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "no log available")
Log: "Backend {backend} failed — exit code {EXIT_CODE}, classified as {ERROR_CLASS}"
Set status = "failed", error = ERROR_TAIL
Log: "PERMANENT failure ({backend}): {ERROR_TAIL}. Pipeline halted — requires user intervention."
Do NOT increment consecutive_failures — this is not a retriable condition
Skip to step 5 (failure handling)
Log: "TRANSIENT failure ({backend}): {ERROR_TAIL}. Skipping to fallback without burning failure slot."
Do NOT increment consecutive_failures
Sleep with jitter before fallback to avoid thundering-herd: `sleep $(awk -v min=1 -v max=4 'BEGIN{srand(); print min+rand()*(max-min)}')`

Emit a structured signal so the triage layer can see WHICH transient pattern fired (gemini-timeout, codex-parse-failed, rate-limit, etc.). Append to _bmad/ralph/events.ndjson: ```bash SIGNAL_NAME="unknown-transient" if echo "$ERROR_TAIL" | grep -qiE "gemini.*timeout|gemini.*timed out|gemini.*killed"; then SIGNAL_NAME="gemini-timeout"; fi if echo "$ERROR_TAIL" | grep -qiE "codex.*parse.*failed|JSONDecodeError|Unexpected end of JSON"; then SIGNAL_NAME="codex-parse-failed"; fi if echo "$ERROR_TAIL" | grep -qiE "rate.?limit|429|Too.?Many.?Requests"; then SIGNAL_NAME="rate-limit"; fi echo "{\"event\":\"orch:execution_failure\",\"backend\":\"{backend}\",\"error\":\"$SIGNAL_NAME\",\"ts\":\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\"}" >> _bmad/ralph/events.ndjson 2>/dev/null || true ```
Set FALLBACK_USED=true and proceed directly to mini-executor fallback below
Increment consecutive_failures count for this backend
Log: "Backend {backend} tool/logic failure (attempt {consecutive_failures}), exit code {EXIT_CODE}"
Do NOT retry inline — the caller workflow controls re-invocation
Set FALLBACK_USED=true
Capture partial output: `PARTIAL_OUTPUT=$(tail -30 "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "no log available")`

Build sharpened fallback prompt: ``` ## Fallback Execution (Original backend "{backend}" failed {consecutive_failures} times)
### Original Task {contents of PROMPT_FILE}
### Failure Context The original backend ({backend}) failed with exit code {EXIT_CODE}. Last 30 lines of output: ``` {PARTIAL_OUTPUT} ```
### Instructions Complete the original task above. The sentinel file instruction is already included. Focus on correctness over speed. If the task seems too large, implement the most critical parts and document what remains in the sentinel file summary. ```
Write sharpened prompt to: `/tmp/orchestrator-prompt-{story_id}-fallback${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}.md`

Execute fallback via codex exec: ```bash FALLBACK_LOG="_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/.fallback${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}-{story_id}.log" # Swap backends freely: claude -p "$(cat ...)" works identically. ${TIMEOUT_CMD:+$TIMEOUT_CMD --signal=SIGTERM --kill-after=60 $TIMEOUT_SECONDS} \ codex exec "$(cat /tmp/orchestrator-prompt-{story_id}-fallback${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}.md)" \ > "$FALLBACK_LOG" 2>&1 EXIT_CODE=$? LOG_FILE="$FALLBACK_LOG" ```
Set RETRY_COUNT=1
Log: "Fallback to codex exec completed with exit code {EXIT_CODE}"

step.title: Collect and Validate Results
step.action: Reuse SENTINEL from step 3 (already includes INVOCATION_SUFFIX for parallel safety)
Check sentinel file existence: `SENTINEL_FOUND=$(test -f "$SENTINEL" && echo true || echo false)`

check.if: backend=codex AND review task AND EXIT_CODE=0
check.action: Parse final JSONL event from log file for additional completion signal: ```bash LAST_EVENT=$(tail -1 "$LOG_FILE") # Cross-reference with sentinel: if JSONL says error but sentinel says completed, # trust the sentinel (agent had more context about actual state) ```

step.action: Run git status to detect files changed
Extract list of modified files from git output
If sentinel exists, also merge files_changed from sentinel JSON
Generate execution summary
If lock_file active, release our file claims

check.if: token_usage is set AND token_usage.measured = true
check.action: Include token_usage in the output for the caller to record via cost tracker: The caller (ralph-iterate or equivalent) MUST call cost_tracker.record() with: - input_tokens = token_usage.input_tokens - output_tokens = token_usage.output_tokens - cached_input_tokens = token_usage.cached_input_tokens - measured = true
Set token_usage = null (caller will use estimated counts instead)

step.title: Handle Failures

check.action: Capture error message and stack trace if available
On CLI backends: `tail -30 "$LOG_FILE"` for diagnostics (NEVER read full log)
Preserve partial work information
Record partial progress if detectable
Note: timeout --kill-after=60 means SIGTERM was sent, then SIGKILL after 60s
Check if sentinel was written before timeout (partial completion)
Log: "Subagent exited 0 but did not produce sentinel file — treating as incomplete"
On CLI backends: `tail -30 "$LOG_FILE"` for diagnostics
This is a new failure mode — caller should consider retry or escalation
Include conflicting file and owner story in error

step.action: Clean up prompt temp file: `rm -f "$PROMPT_FILE" /tmp/orchestrator-prompt-{story_id}-fallback${INVOCATION_SUFFIX}.md`

output.name: status
output.desc: Execution result status. 'incomplete' = exit 0 but no sentinel file

output.name: files_changed
output.desc: List of file paths modified during execution (merged from git status + sentinel)

output.name: summary
output.desc: Human-readable summary of what was done

output.name: error
output.desc: Error message if status is not completed

output.name: log_file
output.desc: Path to log file for CLI backends (codex/gemini). Use tail -30 on failure only.

output.name: exit_code
output.desc: Raw exit code from the subagent process (0=success, 124=SIGTERM timeout, 137=SIGKILL timeout)

output.name: retry_count
output.desc: How many retries were attempted (0 = first attempt succeeded or failed without retry)

output.name: fallback_used
output.desc: Whether mini-executor fallback (codex exec instead of claude -p) was triggered (transient errors trigger immediately; tool/logic errors after 2 consecutive failures)

output.name: error_class
output.desc: Error classification from step 3.5. Transient = rate limit/network; permanent = auth/CLI missing; tool_logic = code/logic error

output.name: sentinel_found
output.desc: Whether the completion sentinel file (_bmad-output/.complete-{story_id}.json) was found

output.name: token_usage
output.desc: Measured token counts when available (codex --json). Fields: input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_input_tokens, measured (bool)

on_error.message: Subagent execution failed (tool/logic error) — see error output and log_file (tail -30 only) for details

on_transient.message: Transient failure (rate limit / network) on {backend} — skipping to fallback without burning failure slot

on_permanent.message: Permanent failure on {backend} (auth / CLI missing / setup error) — pipeline halted, requires user intervention

on_timeout.message: Subagent execution timed out after {timeout_minutes} minutes (SIGTERM sent, SIGKILL after 60s)

on_conflict.message: File conflict detected — another agent has claimed target files

on_prompt_too_large.message: Prompt exceeds size limit for {backend}: {PROMPT_BYTES} bytes (max 500000)

on_incomplete.message: Subagent exited successfully but did not produce completion sentinel — execution may be incomplete
